faq.a: These picks are built from real traveler discussion patterns, then organized into curated shortlists rather than paid placements or generic roundups. The goal is to surface the places and experiences people repeatedly mention when planning trips to 🇬🇷 Greece.

faq.q: Should I start with the hub page or open the individual guides for 🇬🇷 Greece?
